articles.title: Blackstone’s Jon Gray Sees AI Creating ‘Huge Boom’ in Blue Collar Jobs
articles.summary: Blackstone Inc. President Jon Gray said the boom in artificial intelligence will lead to a surge in blue-collar employment as asset managers like his shell out billions on data centers and other infrastructure.

articles.title: Ambuja Cements resets expansion strategy as Karan Adani flags cost pressures and execution gaps
articles.summary: Ambuja Cements said it would defer parts of growth plan, while prioritizing cost discipline and asset stabilization following FY26 revenue miss and margin pressure.

articles.title: Ather Energy cuts losses, moves closer to breakeven as FY26 revenue jumps on scale-up
articles.summary: The electric two-wheeler maker cut its net loss to  ₹517 crore and pushed up revenue 66% in FY26, driven by strong volume growth and a rapidly expanding store network, even as commodity costs remain a drag.

articles.title: Godrej Properties targets  ₹39,000 crore in sales for FY27 after record-breaking year
articles.summary: In FY26, GPL's sales bookings rose 16% year-on-year to  ₹34,171 crore. That was achieved through the sale of 17,513 units spanning 27 million sq ft, the highest ever by an Indian real estate firm.

articles.title: Carlyle buys majority stake in Knack, EqualizeRCM to build AI-led healthcare billing platform
articles.summary: The private equity firm is betting on consolidation in a fragmented US billing services market, with plans to scale via acquisitions and global delivery

articles.title: Citi appoints Raj Rathi as head of mergers & acquisitions in India
articles.summary: Rathi joins Citi from Dream Sports, where he served as head of strategy and corporate development.

articles.title: Central Bank of India expects limited impact from new provisioning rules
articles.summary: Central Bank of India managing director and CEO Kalyan Kumar says it is well buffered against the RBI’s shift to stricter, forward-looking loan-loss provisioning, with existing provisions and strong capital expected to absorb any transition impact,

articles.title: Milky Mist raises  ₹482 crore in pre-IPO round led by Temasek arm
articles.summary: The entire primary investment was led by Jongsong Investments, while promoters Sathishkumar T. and Anitha S. sold 89,43,903 equity shares at  ₹139.76 a share, aggregating roughly  ₹125 crore, as part of a secondary transaction.

articles.title: Repertoire drinking spurs new spirit launches
articles.summary: Nearly a dozen products are either already in market or being introduced through early 2026-27 across whisky, brandy, vodka, gin, rum and tequila.

articles.title: How Navi is sharpening its IPO pitch ahead of a fresh FY27 filing
articles.summary: Navi Ltd plans to file for an IPO in FY27, focusing on profitability and a diversified business model. The fintech aims to attract investors with its offerings in payments, lending, insurance, and investments.

articles.title: NCLAT rejects Vedanta's challenge to approval of Adani's resolution plan for Jaiprakash Associates
articles.summary: Vedanta's challenge to Adani Enterprises' resolution plan for Jaiprakash Associates Ltd was dismissed by the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal. The tribunal found no legal flaws in the creditors' choice, marking a significant setback for Vedanta despite its claims of offering a superior bid.

articles.title: New Mexico seeks child safety restrictions on Meta apps and algorithms in trials 2nd phase
articles.summary: New Mexico seeks child safety restrictions on Meta apps and algorithms in trial's 2nd phase

articles.title: GameStop makes staggering $55.5 billion play to acquire online auction giant eBay
articles.summary: GameStop has proposed a $55.5 billion acquisition of eBay, valuing it at $125.00 per share. GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen says he plans to lead the combined entity

articles.title: Indian equities deserve higher FII allocation, but valuations stretched
articles.summary: India merits a higher allocation given its structural strengths. While the underlying business is strong, the valuations are not attractive, said Ramneek Kundra, chief investment officer at DSP Pension Fund Managers. But India’s premium to emerging markets has come down.

articles.title: A key moment at Tata Trusts as it votes on the reappointment of two vice chairmen at its wealthiest affiliate
articles.summary: An important fallout of the vote will be whether both Srinivasan and Singh can continue as vice-chairmen of Tata Trusts; an adverse outcome would prevent them from holding the titles, as the chairman and vice-chairmen must be trustees of all Tata Trusts.

articles.title: White Whale bets on Blue Tokai, Atomberg via secondaries fund
articles.summary: The Mumbai-based venture capital firm, which also backs startups such as M2P Fintech and iD Fresh, has completed the first close of the fund and expects to reach the final close within the next 12-18 months, co-founder Shapath Parikh told Mint.

articles.title: How Infosys is adapting as GCCs move outsourcing work in-house
articles.summary: The Bengaluru-based IT major has mandated dedicated GCC offerings with embedded AI capabilities across its delivery centres, while also setting aside capacity within its campuses to incubate client-owned tech hubs.

articles.title: In an Age of Doom Scrolling, Asia’s Book Market Is Thriving
articles.summary: The internet was supposed to kill off books. But across much of Asia, a booming market tells a different story.

articles.title: Nestle India flags potential price hikes as West Asia war impacts costs
articles.summary: Nestlé India chairman and managing director Manish Tiwary noted that his team is focused more on things that can be controlled, such as cost optimization, than worry about external headwinds/

articles.title: Vedanta is changing its policy that assured at least 30% profit gets distributed as dividend
articles.summary: Vedanta is replacing its mandatory 30% profit-distribution rule with a discretionary, board-driven dividend policy as it prepares to split into five entities, eliminating the predictable yield that attracted income-focused investors.

articles.title: Warren Buffett tells Tim Cook to 'take a bow' as Apple CEO gets surprise send-off at Berkshire annual meeting
articles.summary: During Berkshire Hathaway's meeting, Warren Buffett praised Tim Cook's pivotal role in Apple's rise. He highlighted how the  $35 billion investment by him in the company is now worth $185 billion.

articles.summary: The choice of a new CEO comes at a crucial time for Air India, which is grappling with heavy losses, heightened regulatory scrutiny after a deadly crash last year, and operational disruptions from the Iran war, which has driven up costs and compounded the effects of Pakistan's airspace ban.

articles.title: Air India cuts international flights until July 2026 as fuel costs and airspace closures bite
articles.summary: Air India will reduce international flights through July as soaring jet fuel prices and West Asia airspace closures make many routes unprofitable, CEO Campbell Wilson has said. The airline group recorded losses exceeding  ₹22,000 crore in FY2026
